name: Propertybase
description: Propertybase Salesforce Edition is Lone Wolf's Salesforce-native real-estate CRM for managing leads, contacts, listings, properties, offers, closings, transactions, commissions, marketing and reporting.
agentUseSummary: Propertybase is visible as a canonical Salesforce product-family preview. Relay will not create a second Salesforce session, expose Propertybase custom objects or configure its guest-user webservices until an exact, reviewed extension of the canonical Salesforce connector exists.

capabilities.label: Review a bounded Propertybase Salesforce extension
capabilities.description: If approved, extend the canonical Salesforce provider with exact-org, read-only Propertybase record summaries that exclude identity, communications, documents and bulk data.

blocked.label: Create duplicate Salesforce provider state
blocked.description: Propertybase must not create a parallel Salesforce session, token, tool or approval surface beside Relay's canonical Salesforce connector.

blocked.label: Capture Propertybase credentials or sessions
blocked.description: Relay will not ask for a Propertybase login, Salesforce security token, session ID, connected-app secret or guest-site token.

blocked.label: Access Propertybase real-estate records
blocked.description: Contacts, companies, leads, requests, listings, properties, offers, closings, commissions, messages and other brokerage records are unavailable.

blocked.label: Configure webservices or change records
blocked.description: Relay will not activate a Force.com guest site, alter sharing rules, generate webservice tokens, route leads or create, update, delete, export or bulk-process records.

blocked.label: Run Propertybase actions from this preview
blocked.description: This preview exposes no runtime actions; approved support must extend the canonical Salesforce connector with exact organization binding, typed Propertybase objects, least privilege, approvals and audits.

approvalProfiles.label: Propertybase Salesforce extension review
approvalProfiles.description: This product-family preview is not connectable. Propertybase-specific data remains unavailable unless it can reuse Relay's canonical Salesforce identity and pass object, field, tenant and privacy review.

runtimeSupport.description: This preview installs no OpenClaw tools; approved Propertybase support must extend the canonical Salesforce provider pack.
This preview installs no Hermes tools; approved Propertybase support must extend the canonical Salesforce provider pack.

providerSetup.blocker: Propertybase Salesforce Edition is a current Salesforce-native CRM with sensitive standard and custom real-estate objects. Its separate public webservices guidance provisions a Force.com guest user, sharing rules and generated tokens for website and lead-routing features. Relay's canonical Salesforce connector currently supports only bounded Account and Opportunity reads and intentionally excludes custom objects, personal records, arbitrary queries and broad API access. Propertybase GO is now a different Lone Wolf product, Front Office.
providerSetup.nextAction: Model Propertybase only as a reviewed extension of the canonical Salesforce connector: reuse its packaged OAuth identity and immutable org/instance binding, enumerate exact Propertybase package/object/field versions, add typed redacted reads only, preserve record-level sharing, and prove permission denial, refresh rotation, revocation and disconnect denial. Treat Front Office as a separate provider and never enable guest-site APIs or ingest session IDs.

evidence.supports: Lone Wolf describes current Propertybase Salesforce Edition as a Salesforce-native CRM spanning leads, listings, transactions, commissions, marketing, reporting and automation.
Lone Wolf distinguishes Propertybase Salesforce Edition from Front Office and states that Front Office was formerly Propertybase GO.
Propertybase documents Salesforce standard Contacts, Companies, Tasks and Events plus custom Requests, Listings, Properties, Offers and Closings objects with API field names.
Propertybase webservices require an organization to create a Force.com guest-user site, grant Apex access and licenses, and configure a tenant-specific HTTPS endpoint.
Activating Propertybase webservices requires guest-user permissions, object access, generated tokens and sharing rules, making that surface unsuitable as a Relay customer authorization flow.
